title: Compatibility paths for streaming, function/tool calls, and structured outputs
creator: Dina Ramos
description:
Goal: deliver a clear, low-friction compatibility and deprecation path that covers streaming responses, function/tool calling semantics, and structured-output variants across SDKs and the hosted API. We will provide: 1) explicit behavior flags for temporary toggles, 2) canonical migration guides and code snippets for common languages, 3) a backward-compatibility test matrix and automated regression harness, and 4) an operational rollout plan (canary -> opt-in -> enforced deprecation).

Motivation: Several customers rely on legacy streaming framing and permissive function-calling behavior. Upcoming API changes (structured_output_v2, strict_function_calling, and streaming_chunking optimizations) improve correctness and downstream parsing but risk regressions for integrations that parse tokens incrementally or rely on implicit tool-calling fallbacks. This work reduces blast radius while enabling the platform to retire legacy paths after measurable adoption thresholds.

Acceptance criteria:
- Behavior-flag set defined and approved (names, semantics, default values).
- Migration guide drafted with examples (Node, Python, Java) and sample SDK patches.
- Backward-compatibility test matrix covering: streaming binary/JSON framing, partial token parsing, function args round-tripping, KV cache boundary cases.
- CI harness (ENG-4021) runs nightly against golden prompts and reports regressions to a dashboard.
- Rollout schedule with telemetry thresholds and rollback triggers published to Console and internal handbook.
- Customer-facing deprecation notice template and support playbook prepared.
updates: 2026-02-12: Ticket created after PM sync with APAC pilot customers reporting broken streaming parsers when we introduced chunked 'event' envelopes.

2026-02-18: Drafted initial list of behavior flags and semantics. Proposed flags: 'legacy_streaming=true|false', 'function_call_mode=compat|strict', 'structured_output_v=1|2'. Shared with Eng for feedback (ENG-4021).

2026-02-24: Engineering input: 'legacy_streaming' needs two sub-modes to handle CRLF vs LF framing; suggested 'legacy_streaming=none|crlf|len-prefix'. Added to spec. Eng estimate increases by 1 point.
2026-03-01: Design review (DES-221) requested for migration doc UX and Console toggles. Design asked for a banner template and automated 'migrate' checklist in the Console's route settings.

2026-03-05: PM/Eng walkthrough of backward-compatibility matrix. Agreed to include 120 golden prompts covering: conversational chat with embedded tool calls, multi-tool disambiguation, streaming partial JSON, and ambiguous tokenization edge-cases. Assigned ownership: ENG-4120 implement harness, QA leads to curate prompts.

2026-03-10: PR: github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/7273 created with behavior-flag parsing and environment toggles (internal only). Added link to PR in links. Action: schedule canary run for week of 2026-03-17 and draft customer comms.

Next steps: complete SDK migration snippets, finalize deprecation timeline, and run first-nightly backward-compatibility test. Prepare customer support runbook and regression playbook for SRE pager escalation.
